use_case: Admissions applicant scoring: ranks inquiries and applicants by predicted likelihood to enroll and sets the order and channel of admissions outreach
vendor_or_model: Admissions CRM vendor's applicant scoring feature (predictive model; not generative), in SYS-H3
data_categories: Inquiry and application data; prior education; program and start term; age; home ZIP code; communications activity; financial aid interest flag from the application (no FAFSA data)
human_in_the_loop: None designed today: low-band applicants get automated email only. Conditions add a human review rule so no applicant is deprioritized without review
applicable_laws: Title VI; Title IX; Section 504; Age Discrimination Act; Colo. SB26-189 deployer duties for Colorado applicants from 2027-01-01; California CPPA ADMT rules (11 CCR 7200 et seq.) for California applicants, counsel review; N61-R02 (16 CFR 314.4(f)) vendor oversight; FERPA only once an applicant attends (34 CFR 99.3); FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: In production since 2025; continue with conditions (POAM-022); no new scoring uses until conditions are met

use_case: Student-success risk scoring: predicts which enrolled students may withdraw or fail a course so advisors can offer help
vendor_or_model: College model built by the director of institutional research on the student data warehouse; scores shown to advisors through the Campus Platform analytics module (AI-006)
build_or_buy: Build (configured on the sister division's product)
data_categories: LMS activity; attendance; grades; credits; account holds; modality; age; Pell eligibility and other FAFSA-derived fields (to be removed); clinic visit counts from the utilization extract until 2026-08-07 (removed); outputs: score, band, top 3 factors
consequential_decision_category: None directly (routes supportive outreach); re-tier to Education if used for admission, aid, standing, or placement
human_in_the_loop: Advisor reviews the record and decides whether and how to reach out; overrides recorded; no automated action
applicable_laws: N61-R01 FERPA (34 CFR 99.31(a)(1)(ii)); HEA sec. 483 limits on FAFSA data; 45 CFR 164.502 and 34 CFR 99.33(a) (clinic data, now removed); Title VI; Section 504; Age Discrimination Act
status: In production for all advisors; continue with conditions (FAFSA-derived inputs out by 2026-11-30)

use_case: Online proctoring AI flags and identity verification for online exams
vendor_or_model: Proctoring vendor's flagging model and identity verification (face matching), in SYS-H5
data_categories: Exam video and audio; identity document and face images; device and browser events; outputs: flags with timestamps
consequential_decision_category: None directly (faculty decide integrity cases); re-tier to Education if flags start cases without faculty review
human_in_the_loop: Faculty review every flag and the video before any academic integrity case; students can contest
applicable_laws: N61-R01 FERPA (99.31(a)(1)(i)(B) vendor terms); Section 504 (testing accommodations); Title VI; state biometric privacy laws where students reside (generic; counsel review)
status: In production; continue with conditions (written review rule and flag-rate monitoring by 2027-03-31)

use_case: K-12 AI tutoring assistant: generative tutor for students in grades 3 to 12 in the District Platform
vendor_or_model: Hosted large language model from a third-party model provider (zero data retention, no training), integrated into SYS-E2
data_categories: Children's and students' prompts and tutor responses; grade level; course context; teacher dashboards (about 160,000 users under 13)
consequential_decision_category: None directly; children interact with it directly (High by the Group AI Standard). Re-assess if outputs are used for grading or placement
human_in_the_loop: Teachers see conversations in dashboards; districts can turn the feature off; responses filtered; students told they are talking to AI
applicable_laws: N61-R03 COPPA (16 CFR 312.5(a), 312.8(b)-(c), 312.10); N61-R01 FERPA as a school official for districts; district contracts and state student privacy laws (generic); SOC 2 commitments (CC2.3, CC8.1, CC9.2); N51-R01 FTC Act Section 5 (safety claims)
status: Pilot in 140 districts since 2026-01; continue in districts with written authorization only; no new districts until conditions are met (POAM-013, POAM-014)

data_categories: Attendance; grades; course failures; discipline counts; grade level; outputs: indicator and factors
consequential_decision_category: Education (district decisions); Education Software is the developer

status: In production; developer documentation and intended-use statements due before 2027-01-01

use_case: Ambient clinical documentation (AI scribe) drafting visit notes from recorded conversations
vendor_or_model: AI scribe vendor (speech-to-text and language model) under a BAA with no-training terms
data_categories: Visit audio; transcripts; draft notes (PHI of nonstudent patients; FERPA treatment records of student patients)
consequential_decision_category: None directly (documentation); re-tier to Health care if suggestion features are enabled
human_in_the_loop: Clinician reviews, edits, and signs every note; recording starts only after all-party consent

status: Pilot at campus clinics; continue; no expansion until the consent field is mandatory (2026-12-31)
